resolution: Treat the Starlight Night Walk as a long shot. Do not pin the itinerary to it. Creatrip is the only sales channel for the Oct 21-24 foreigner-only sessions (NOL World is not used in 2026). The live Creatrip page (spot 13949, checked Oct 6, 2026) shows isSoldOut=true for every session. There are 8 sessions in total, 2 per night, with at most 38 people each, so about 304 seats overall. Each person can buy at most 2 tickets, so a group of 3 needs two separate bookers. You cannot buy on the day. Sales for each date close at 23:59 KST two days before. Cancellations get a full refund up to 3 days before and no refund after that, so released seats mostly reappear before each date's free-cancel cutoff. They tend to come back 1-2 at a time, which makes 3 seats in one session unlikely. The session times are settled at 18:20-20:10 and 19:30-21:20 (Creatrip listing, Korea Times, Korean press). The 18:30/19:40 times in events.json are wrong. The price is 60,000 KRW per person (US$44.81 on Creatrip, or $42.12 for members). Ticketlink general sessions do not run Oct 21-24, because those nights are foreigner-only. The only general nights in the trip window are Sat Oct 17 and Sun Oct 18. They were sold by lottery in August and then first-come from Aug 28, they are in Korean, and they are almost certainly gone. The fallback is confirmed and is good. Changgyeonggung is open 09:00-21:00 (last entry 20:00, closed Mon). It runs the 'Mulbit Yeonhwa' media-art night on Wed-Sun, Oct 7 - Nov 1, with pond-show sessions at 19:00, 19:30 and 20:00 (about 16 min each). That show costs 1,000 KRW including admission, via Ticketlink (up to 4 per person) or Creatrip for foreigners. The rest of the light route can be seen with normal admission. Deoksugung is open 09:00-21:00 (closed Mon). Under the weekly 'Culture Day' policy, every Wednesday is free at Deoksugung since Aug 2026 and at Changgyeonggung, Changdeokgung (not Huwon) and Jongmyo since Oct 2026. Gyeongbokgung is not included yet. So Wed Oct 21 is a free palace evening. Confidence: high on sold-out status, times, price and rules; medium on Mulbit availability (not checked live) and on Wednesday-free details.

events.dates: Wed Oct 21 - Sat Oct 24, 2026; 4 days, 8 sessions
events.times: Session 1: 18:20-20:10. Session 2: 19:30-21:20. Check-in opens 20 min before at Gyejodang (parking-lot side, east of Gyeongbokgung). Late arrivals may be refused.

Full refund at least 3 days before; no refund 2 days before or later. Physical passport required for everyone. Showed isSoldOut=true on Oct 6, 2026.
events.notes: Max 38 per session. Ages 7+. Route: Oesojubang royal meal (Doseok Surasang, 12-dish) with court music, then Jibokjae & Palujeong interiors, an English-guided talk at Geoncheonggung, and a special viewing of Hyangwonjeong. Cancelled for rain only if more than 5 mm is forecast at 11:00 that day (full refund). Free-cancel cutoffs, when released seats are most likely: about Oct 18 for Oct 21, Oct 19 for Oct 22, Oct 20 for Oct 23, Oct 21 for Oct 24. Sales close Oct 19, 20, 21 and 22 at 23:59 KST respectively.

tips: Settle the times as 18:20 and 19:30 (about 110 min each). The 18:30/19:40 in events.json is wrong.

Starlight: if the itinerary happens to have Seoul nights on Oct 21-23, both travelers who book (2 tickets max each) should check Creatrip spot 13949 daily from about Oct 14 until each date's free-cancel cutoff (about Oct 18-21). Do not move Busan (Sat Oct 24) or the Gangwon weekdays to chase it.

Weekly Culture Day: from Oct 2026, Changgyeonggung, Changdeokgung (not the Huwon garden), Jongmyo and Deoksugung are free every Wednesday. Gyeongbokgung is not yet included and stays 3,000 KRW (and closed Tuesdays).
Book a Mulbit Yeonhwa pond-show slot (1,000 KRW) on Ticketlink or Creatrip for whichever Wed-Sun night is in Seoul. Even if it is full, the rest of the lit palace is walk-up until 21:00.
warnings: The Starlight foreigner sessions are sold out (Creatrip isSoldOut=true on Oct 6, 2026). NOL World/Interpark Global is not a 2026 channel. Ticketlink general sessions do not run Oct 21-24.

Starlight tickets are capped at 2 per person, and orders of more than 2 may be cancelled outright. A party of 3 needs 2 separate bookers and passports that match the names entered. Korean citizens cannot attend.
